decisions.arrival: a latent FAMILY_CANDIDATE / CASE MAPPING arrival state constrained by independent authored evidence (warm or flushed peripheries with a low pressure, a filled refill, preserved or raised flow); never inverted from the MAP residual
decisions.composition: multiplicative and normalized at arrival: target = (1 + g s) / (1 + g s0) x (1 + k b0) / (1 + k b). The two causes coexist without double counting: the compensation answers the oxygen deficit only, the burden is written by a family only
decisions.guard: a burden large enough to take the target below T's guard parks T at 0.1 with the clamp recorded (CHANNEL_BOUNDS, 'guard only'), as any channel does: no clinical ceiling is chosen
decisions.magnitudes: every magnitude UNSET: no distributive gain, no anaphylaxis or sepsis tone loss, no epinephrine effect, no pressure -> tone gain; deficit_to_tone_gain stays PROVISIONAL (0.5 is a carried structural point, not an approved value)
decisions.owner: the core stays the T channel's only writer (integration._vascular_tone); P2J-2's refusal of a second writer is not relaxed, and no family delta on T is introduced
decisions.reader: vasodilatory_burden_to_tone_gain, UNSET (None) by default; with it UNSET the target is P2J-2's exactly and a vasodilation change is refused
decisions.representation: the primary loss of vascular tone a disease process causes: an auxiliary common input, never a new canonical V/T/P/R/L/G/W/D/N channel
decisions.residuals: a common causal signal, never an observable residual fit: no MAP residual is inverted into a burden
decisions.scope: one new common auxiliary input (vasodilatory_burden) and its one reader of the common tone target; no anaphylaxis migration, no epinephrine, no clinical tone calibration, no pressure -> tone, no systemic-stress vascular reader, no consciousness work
decisions.timing: P2J-2's explicit one-minute lag, unchanged; the burden is a state written by a family, so no pressure -> tone path and no same-step loop is introduced

legacy.classification: DISEASE_SPECIFIC_BP_AND_HR_EQUATION: the legacy family moves SBP and HR directly from its own severity, which is exactly what the common core must not reproduce; P2W-1 adds a cause (the burden) and lets the certified pressure path produce the pressure

probes.V1: no distributive signal: exactly the current behaviour (and a change is refused with the reader UNSET)
probes.V11: the systemic stress affects the HR only, not the tone
probes.V12: beta-blockade does not change the tone
probes.V13: arrival exactness preserved at any arrival burden
probes.V14: no recursion and no unstable same-step MAP / T loop
probes.V2: more distributive tone loss lowers the effective tone, by its own gain
probes.V3: more common compensation raises the effective tone at a deficit above arrival's
probes.V4: both active: the compensation partially opposes the vasodilation without erasing it
probes.V5: a severe vasodilation stays dominant; T's guard holds the channel with the clamp recorded
probes.V6: a distributive signal alone alters no other channel or auxiliary state directly
probes.V7: GI exact with the distributive signal absent

criteria: the architecture is minimal and declared: one auxiliary field, one arrival anchor, one writer record, one gain, with their refusals, and the core still the T channel's only writer (representation, reader audit, audit)
the composition is monotone in both causes: more burden never raises the tone, more compensation never lowers it at a deficit above arrival's (V2, V3)
the two causes coexist without double counting: the compensation opposes the vasodilation partially and never erases it, and a severe vasodilation stays dominant (V4, V5)
the distributive signal alters no other channel or auxiliary state directly, and neither the systemic stress nor the beta-blockade reaches the tone (V6, V11, V12)
arrival exactness and the explicit lag are preserved: the arrival tone is 1 at any arrival burden and there is no same-step MAP / tone loop (V13, V14)
every magnitude stays UNSET and no observable is inverted into a burden (the parameter state, the signature)
nothing prior changes by default: with the reader UNSET every prior reading is exact and the committed families are untouched (V1, V7-V10)
P2V-1's record reproduces on its tree and every other common file is P2V-1's (the non-regression, the proof)
readiness.rule: Predeclared. READY when every criterion holds; otherwise NOT_READY with the first failing criterion

the two causes coexist without double counting: the compensation opposes the vasodilation partially and never erases it, and a severe vasodilation stays dominant (V4, V5)
the distributive signal alters no other channel or auxiliary state directly, and neither the systemic stress nor the beta-blockade reaches the tone (V6, V11, V12)
arrival exactness and the explicit lag are preserved: the arrival tone is 1 at any arrival burden and there is no same-step MAP / tone loop (V13, V14)
every magnitude stays UNSET and no observable is inverted into a burden (the parameter state, the signature)
nothing prior changes by default: with the reader UNSET every prior reading is exact and the committed families are untouched (V1, V7-V10)
P2V-1's record reproduces on its tree and every other common file is P2V-1's (the non-regression, the proof)

readiness.rule: Predeclared. READY when every criterion holds; otherwise NOT_READY with the first failing criterion
